title: Should You Buy the Invesco QQQ ETF After the Recent Nasdaq Sell-Off? History Offers a Crystal-Clear Answer.
title_zh: 在最近的纳斯达克抛售之后，您应该购买 Invesco QQQ ETF 吗？历史给出了清晰的答案。

title: Blackstone (BX) Sells Northern Virginia Data Centers In $3.5 Billion Digital Realty Deal
title_zh: Blackstone (BX) 以 35 亿美元的 Digital Realty 交易出售北弗吉尼亚数据中心
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) is exiting major Northern Virginia data center investments in a US$3.5b transaction with Digital Realty. The deal involves Blackstone selling significant data center stakes that were originally acquired within the past three years.
summary_zh: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) 正在与 Digital Realty 进行 35 亿美元的交易，退出北弗吉尼亚数据中心的主要投资。该交易涉及黑石出售过去三年内最初收购的大量数据中心股权。

title: HSBC Weighs Turkey Exit as Emirates NBD Explores Acquisition Deal
title_zh: 阿联酋国民银行 (Emirates NBD) 探索收购交易，汇丰银行考虑退出土耳其
summary: HSBC is reportedly exploring a sale of its Turkey business to Emirates NBD, extending its global restructuring while sharpening its focus on core growth markets.
summary_zh: 据报道，汇丰银行正在考虑将其土耳其业务出售给阿联酋国民银行，以扩大其全球重组，同时加强对核心增长市场的关注。

title: Does KKR’s (KKR) India Hospital Deal And Fee Shift Reveal A New Earnings Playbook?
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 印度医院交易和费用调整是否揭示了新的盈利策略？
summary: KKR recently entered advanced talks to acquire Sweden-based Medicover’s 66.9% stake in its Indian hospital business for at least US$1.05 billion, while also reporting quarter-to-date monetization income above US$900 million, mostly from realized performance fees.
summary_zh: KKR 最近进入高级谈判，以至少 10.5 亿美元收购总部位于瑞典的 Medicover 在其印度医院业务中 66.9% 的股份，同时报告本季度迄今的货币化收入超过 9 亿美元，其中大部分来自已实现的绩效费用。

title: KKR (KKR) Eyes $1 Billion Plus Medicover Hospitals India Deal
title_zh: KKR (KKR) 着眼于印度 10 亿美元加医疗保险医院交易
summary: KKR is reported to be in advanced talks to acquire a majority stake in Medicover Hospitals India. The potential deal could be valued at more than $1b and would expand KKR's healthcare platform in India.
summary_zh: 据报道，KKR 正在就收购印度 Medicover Hospitals 多数股权进行深入谈判。这笔潜在交易的价值可能超过 10 亿美元，并将扩大 KKR 在印度的医疗保健平台。
